messages:
Marina: perf-bot flagged a nightly regression on the small-batch bench, p95 jumped ~35% around 02:15 UTC. Anyone on call who can triage?
perf-bot: ALERT: nightly-ci / small-batch p95 +35% (baseline 82ms -> 111ms). run: https://ci.example.com/runs/9876 — sample artifacts attached.
AJ: seeing it, pulling the run. Can someone paste the summary stats and the top slow traces?
Marina: pasted below (from artifacts):
```
summary: small-batch - p50: 37ms p95: 111ms p99: 190ms
compare: baseline p95: 82ms (+35%)
slowest stack: runtime::batcher::schedule -> kernel::scheduler::pick_core -> kvcache::serialize
```
Sophia: :eyes: I noticed a kernel scheduler tweak landed yesterday (PR 3208) that changed thread affinity for multi-gpu hosts. Could be related.
Lukas: I can bisect the nightly CI between commits 9a1f..a3bc to confirm. Any preference for strategy — full bisect or narrow to infra vs runtime?
AJ: start with a quick binary search on the nightly range to find the commit that created the delta. If it points at infra changes, we'll loop in infra. If runtime, assign to @sophia/@lukas.
oncall-ops: heads up, the bisect will spawn extra CI runs; confirm we want to let them run or pause other nightly jobs?
Marina: go ahead, prioritize this bisect — let nightly continue but deprioritize long GPU tests for the next hour.
ci-bot: queued bisect job #bisect-772 for range 9a1f..a3bc. ETA ~20m per bisect step. Logs: https://ci.example.com/bisect/772
Lukas: starting bisect now. repro command I'm using locally for quick checks: `./bench --suite small-batch --runs 50 --seed nightly --rps 60 --profile`. Will report the culprit commit.
AJ: if bisect points to PR 3208, can we try reverting the scheduler tweak in a canary to validate quickly?
Sophia: yes, I can cut a canary revert patch if bisect flags 3208. I also want to capture perf counters from the failing run (sched migration counts + GPU util). Marina can you enable perf traces for the next run?
Marina: enabled perf traces on the canary pool, added `--trace=sched,migration,gpu` to collector.
perf-bot: bisect step 3/6: candidate commit a1b2c flagged — p95 back to baseline. step 4/6: candidate commit a2b3c flagged — p95 elevated.
Lukas: bisect narrowed to commit a2b3c (PR 3208) — reproduces on staging. I pulled flamegraphs; main diff is increased scheduler spin/wait when batching small requests.
Sophia: cutting a revert PR now: https://github.com/redwood/engine/pull/3235 — rolling to canary.
AJ: assign cross-check to @Lukas to confirm impact, @Sophia to run perf counters. If revert fixes, we'll merge and backfill release notes and follow up with a proper scheduler fix.
ci-bot: canary deploy of PR 3235 started. job: https://ci.example.com/deploys/4455
Lukas: canary results coming in — small-batch p95 back to 84ms on canary hosts, KV serialize path latency unchanged, scheduler wait reduced in flamegraph.
Marina: excellent. Please keep monitoring the next two nightly runs. If stable we merge revert and cut a patch release.
oncall-ops: FYI I bumped the priority of the revert merge to P1 and notified SRE to watch rollback windows.
Sophia: will follow up with a writeup of root cause and the intended fix plan in the morning.
Marina: thanks team. Followups: @Lukas to merge after one more canary validation, @Sophia to document root cause, @AJ to check if any customers hit impacted latency (esp. Dedicated pools).
Lukas: merging after final canary check in ~10m.
Marina: update 02:54 UTC — merged revert. Nightly alerts suppressed; will reopen if anything spikes. Great job everyone :thumbsup:
